title: E-QTM-0056: sub-gap transmission decays exponentially with the exact walk rate arccosh(cos omega / cos mass)...
purpose: Experiment E-QTM-0056 in the quantum arena: sub-gap transmission decays exponentially with the exact walk rate arccosh(cos omega / cos mass), rejecting the continuum Dirac rate by seventeen percent at the same parameters while converging to it in the continuum limit, the discrete tunneling law as a hardware-testable prediction.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
